comparison.objective: Push an umbrella runner until its spring latch engages, then lift the umbrella; candidate locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a handle while translating a sleeve against a spring versus coaxial rotary adjustment and jam-nut counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Runner latched, released, and umbrella lifted versus angle retained after locknut tightening and repeated gripper cycles.
comparison.reason: Generic bimanual stabilization and post-action verification do not make the latch task an adjustment-lock duplicate.
